title: Battle of Giurgiu (1595)
text: The Battle of Giurgiu, also known as the Bridge Disaster, took place on 27–30 October 1595. It was part of the Long Turkish War (1593–1606), a border conflict between the Christian powers and the Ottoman Empire over Balkan territories. The battle ended with the combined Transylvanian–Wallachian army driving the Ottomans out of Wallachia, which was completely liberated from Ottoman forces.
